baseline.scope: Same-recording development diagnostic, publisher image annotations. No labels enter prediction. Region screen requires current paint-checked overhead geometry. No physical accuracy or held-out claim.

wider_ball_motion_trial.scope: Same-recording development diagnostic, publisher image annotations. No labels enter prediction. Region screen requires current paint-checked overhead geometry. No physical accuracy or held-out claim.

player_funnel.matching_policy: 40 pixel maximum center distance; 10 pixel ambiguity margin against competing references and detections
player_funnel.warning: The 370 raw matches in the trial reports use the older asymmetric anchor scorer. Use 358 for comparison with 332 tracked observations. Unmatched predictions are not automatically false positives; annotations omit officials/nonparticipants.

conclusion: Neither pitch-region screening nor wider ball-motion association is enabled in production. Ball detector contains a reference-near candidate on 29/31 frames, but temporal selection resolves none; player detector coverage is the dominant player bottleneck.
